Module com.hft.systems.affinity
Package com.faster.affinity.performance

Class HFTPerformanceProfiler

java.lang.Object
com.faster.affinity.performance.HFTPerformanceProfiler
public final class HFTPerformanceProfiler extends Object
Performance profiler specifically designed for HFT optimization monitoring. Tracks latency, throughput, and efficiency metrics for hot path operations. FIXED: Manual cache line padding replaces @Contended for module compatibility.
